result.title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
result.summary: GUI grounding on high-resolution screens fails mostly on small targets, and zooming in is a common training-free remedy. However, most existing zooming pipelines do not match the zoom to the target's size, accept the zoomed answer unconditionally and never revisit a wrong answer. To address these issues, we propose AdaGround, a training-free framework with three components: (1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming, which sets the magnification, field of view and zoom depth of each sample from the model's own estimate of the target size; (2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement, which uses one marked-click Yes/No verifier to keep or reject each zoom, choose between zoom chains, trigger re-grounding and, with an existence query, decide when to abstain; and (3) Compositional Structure Grounding, which composes spreadsheet cells from their headers. On Qwen3-VL models, AdaGround surpasses state-of-the-art training-free zooming methods and many trained GUI models, improving accuracy over the backbone by 7.4 to 20.6 points on OSWorld-G and ScreenSpot-Pro, and its gains carry over to held-out UI-Vision. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 GUI grounding 框架 AdaGround：按模型自身对目标尺寸的估计自适应设置放大倍率、视野和 zoom 深度，并用一个带标记点击的 Yes/No 验证器决定保留或拒绝每次放大、在放大链之间选择、触发重新定位，以及通过存在性查询决定何时弃答。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及高分辨率小目标下的视觉证据获取与停止决策，其验证器门控的 zoom 链和弃答机制可供核查 LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本，以及非 latent 管线中视觉证据筛选的有效性。
